	Enabled        bool     `json:"enabled" mapstructure:"enabled"`
	AllowedOrigins []string `json:"allowedOrigins,omitempty" mapstructure:"allowed_origins"`
}

	v.SetDefault("cors", map[string]any{

+func stringToSliceHookFunc(_ reflect.Type, t reflect.Type, data interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+	value, ok := data.(string)
+	if !ok || t != reflect.TypeOf([]string{}) {
+		return data, nil
+	}
+
+	fields := strings.FieldsFunc(value, func(r rune) bool {
+		return unicode.IsSpace(r) || r == ','
+	})
+	if len(fields) == 0 {
+		return []string{}, nil
+	}
+
+	return fields, nil

+func TestStringToSliceHookFunc(t *testing.T) {

+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{"foo.com", "bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "comma compatibility",
+			input:  "foo.com,bar.com",
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{"foo.com", "bar.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "empty string",
+			input:  "",
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "whitespace only",
+			input:  " \t\n ",
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "existing sequence",
+			input:  []string{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"},
+			target: stringSlice,
+			want:   []string{"foo.com bar.com", "baz.com"},
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "non-string source",
+			input:  42,

+			want:   42,
+		},
+		{
+			name:   "non-string-slice target",
+			input:  "foo.com bar.com",

+			want:   "foo.com bar.com",

item.text:
Updated [config.go](/app/internal/config/config.go) so scalar strings decoded into `[]string` split on whitespace, including repeated spaces, tabs, and newlines. Comma-separated values still work. Empty strings produce an empty slice, while sequences and other source types pass through unchanged.

Added YAML and ENV regression coverage in [config_test.go](/app/internal/config/config_test.go). Two delegated agents reviewed the decoder and tests; I integrated and verified the patch. `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./internal/config` and `git diff --check` pass.
